name_en: USA: Anthony Bourdain AI voice in documentary sparks ethics backlash
description: Regisseur Morgan Neville liess für die Dokumentation 'Roadrunner' ueber den verstorbenen Koch Anthony Bourdain dessen Stimme per KI synthetisieren, um Saetze vorzulesen, die Bourdain nie laut gesprochen hatte (rund 60 Sekunden). Neville machte den Deepfake nicht kenntlich und behauptete, Einverstaendnis eingeholt zu haben - was Bourdains Ex-Frau öffentlich bestritt. Der Fall loeste eine breite Debatte ueber Einwilligung und Transparenz bei posthumer Stimm-Klonung aus.

description_en: For the documentary 'Roadrunner' about the late chef Anthony Bourdain, director Morgan Neville had Bourdain's voice synthesised via AI to read lines he had never spoken aloud (about 60 seconds). Neville did not disclose the deepfake and claimed he had obtained consent - which Bourdain's ex-wife publicly disputed. The case triggered a wide debate about consent and transparency in posthumous voice cloning.
